solutions.title: Running-sum brute force
solutions.strategy: Start at each index and extend right while maintaining the current interval sum.

timeComplexity.explanation: Every start/end pair can be inspected.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Only counters and the current sum are stored.

solutions.title: Prefix counts
solutions.strategy: Store how many prior prefix sums would pair with the current prefix to produce k.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each number performs one map lookup and update.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The prefix-count map can store one entry per index.
